update_l4_facts.description: Lets JIN send a focused update, merge, or create instruction to the Long-Term facts maintainer.
rules: JIN can update, merge, or create durable Long-Term facts through this marker.
Use this marker only to update or merge existing durable facts, or create a genuinely new durable fact.
Emit fulfilled with plain English text inside the marker:
Write concise English instruction. Update/merge: name exact F<number> IDs. Create: describe the new fact.
